gen-gf-paprika-gf-allerta: Paprika fills the line with lowercase that behaves like capitals, scattered wide and breathing through hollow counters. Allerta follows with loose tracking and a tall x-height, so a long passage should drift by easily.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-alumni-sans: Commanding Paprika scatters its letters and lets its lowercase swell to capital size. Alumni Sans is the quieter partner, with ascenders barely clearing the x-height, though pushing it large would lose the modest weight shifts it does best.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Loud, loose and loaded with attitude, Paprika sets its wide-spaced letters against a tight, compact texture. And Alumni Sans Pinstripe, with oversized lowercase beside small capitals, should carry a long passage in a dense, steady column.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Alumni Sans SC squeezes its letters together, with lowercase that looks oversized beside its own capitals. But Paprika is far wilder, and shrinking it down would waste how its lowercase fills the line like capitals.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-anaheim: Expressive Paprika scatters its letters across the line, its lowercase standing up like capitals, with hollow counters breathing in between. Anaheim packs rounded forms into a dense huddle the eye slides through.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-arsenal: Arsenal keeps a close-knit string of letters with a tall x-height. Paprika is the one for making a statement, with its scattered, capital-like lowercase, while Arsenal's gentle weight shifts do the quiet work of carrying text.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-arsenal-sc: Arsenal SC shows a faint but real thick-thin shift in a tight fit, its mouths wide as a cut tin lid. Arsenal SC beneath Paprika's scattered, capital-like lowercase should read as a tidy, gentle stretch of text.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-asimovian: Approachable Asimovian builds tall lowercase from one tube-like stroke. Paprika does the shouting, with scattered letters and hollow counters, while Asimovian simply keeps a steady, uniform line going underneath.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-basic: Lowercase that fills the line like capitals is Paprika's signature, set wide with hollow, breathing counters. And Basic gives it a clean, professional counterweight, with only a gentle bump up from small letters to capitals.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-cal-sans: Modern Cal Sans runs a single stroke width through its whole alphabet, with short ascenders and a tall x-height, under Paprika's scattered, capital-like lowercase. Expect a smooth, friendly read.
